dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent and sharp pale boundaries along the margins of the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: High-contrast area of fine, dense, dark-centered scales forming a semi-circular footprint on the posterior neck.

other_distinctive_markers: Sharp transition between the fine, dense vermiculation of the nape and the much larger, broadly-fringed scapular and mantle feathers.
